title: The Bay of Pigs and the missile crisis
goal: Follow the invasion of 1961 and the missile crisis of 1962, and say what was about to happen with estar a punto de.

items: I can say who landed at the Bay of Pigs and what happened.
I can say how the missiles came to Cuba and how the United States found them.
I can describe the blockade of 1962.
I can say how the crisis ended.
I can say that something was about to happen with estar a punto de + infinitive.
